articles.summary: Alignment with the FDA across proposed study parameters of RESTORE, a 16-week registrational study evaluating NVG-291 in chronic tetraplegia. Primary endpoint will be the change from baseline in GRASSP Quantitative Prehension at Week 12, a validated functional endpoint designed to capture improvement in fine-motor hand use, the highest priority domain in tetraplegia.
